summary: Users report severe app technical issues, billing scams, and poor customer service. Multiple reviews highlight privacy concerns, membership cancellation difficulties, and safety risks at Planet Fitness locations.

actions: Prioritize fixing app technical issues and ensuring compatibility with older devices
Implement transparent billing processes with upfront payment options and eliminate auto-charge penalties
Enhance security protocols and obtain explicit user consent for data collection
details: Reviews consistently criticize the app's instability, including data fetching failures and compatibility problems. Billing scams involving automatic charges and hidden fees are major concerns, with users alleging predatory practices. Membership cancellation processes are described as overly cumbersome, requiring in-person interactions. Safety risks, particularly for women, and inadequate customer support further damage trust. The crowd meter feature is deemed unreliable, and lack of gym closure notifications adds to user frustration.
